page.layout: One text column, centred on the page, with a running head above it and a catchword at lower right. The left edge holds fragments of the neighbouring page (show-through and gutter), which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: ragem, & excidium & his pe-ora centuplo, egregius iste pro-ulset agger. Si genio indultum uberius, si plus æquo compota-um fuerit, semotis arbitris indi-ium omne sepelitur in caligine: Nec titubantem in reditu pedem otant cum falsâ irrisione, latè de-populata jam & cæca fora: At an-eambuloni suspicionem eximit ncrepatio : Nam accelerat cum ucerna, retardàtve nimium: Et vicinior radius perstringit ocu-um; remotior absorbetur ab o-paco; Ambo mali duces: Quid mi-rum si herus cespitet? Domum am reversum, quantocyùs exci-pit cubile : Tum vapido, qui ce-rebrum circumvolat, fumo, spon-te sociat se Somnus: à subsidio jam intrepidus, jam curarum, quas ante fugiebat, incuriosus: Et illabens deciduo cum rore, mul-cet

page.notes: The first word "ragem" and the first letters of several lines are cut by the gutter and partly hidden; the fragments are kept as printed. The final word "cet" stands alone at lower right and is the catchword.
